_readme: One entry per project. The Stop hook (hooks/verify_on_stop.py) finds the projects Claude wrote to during the session, by GitHub repo or by folder, and runs their `static` commands before Claude can hand back. `{changed}` expands to the changed files matching `changed_glob`. `timing`, `see` and `tests` are for Claude, the hook ignores them. Copy to ~/.claude/verify.json.

projects.name: web-app
projects.timing: typecheck 12 s; eslint on changed files only (the whole repo takes 7 min)
projects.see: start the `web-app` config from launch.json, click through the flow, read console and network, finish with a screenshot
projects.tests: npx vitest run <the test next to the changed file>

projects.name: python-service
projects.see: uv run python -m service --dry-run, read the output

projects.name: scripts (no git repo of its own)
projects.see: scripts that send mail or call a model are never run to verify: syntax only, and say so
